Cozy Voice Chat API 1.1.0

Public API for addons to Cozy Voice Chat, a proximity voice chat mod for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1. API version 1, mod 1.1.0 or newer, MIT licensed.

Only net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api and its subpackages are public; everything else in the mod is internal. The full guide with more examples is API.md.

Quick start

1. Gradle (JitPack)


repositories {
    maven { url 'https://jitpack.io' }
}
dependencies {
    // API only: no Minecraft method references, so no fg.deobf is needed
    compileOnly 'com.github.ElgerElg.CozyVoiceChat:cozyvoicechat-api:<tag>'
    // optional: the real mod in dev runs
    runtimeOnly fg.deobf('com.github.ElgerElg.CozyVoiceChat:cozyvoicechat:<tag>')
    minecraftLibrary 'io.github.jaredmdobson:concentus:1.0.2'
}

<tag> is a release tag of the repository, e.g. v1.1.0. Do not ship the API jar inside your mod; players install Cozy Voice Chat itself.

2. mods.toml

[[dependencies.yourmodid]]
modId="cozyvoicechat"
mandatory=true            # or false for an optional integration
versionRange="[1.1.0,)"
ordering="AFTER"
side="BOTH"

3. Get the API


if (CozyVoiceApi.isAvailable()) {
    CozyVoiceApi api = CozyVoiceApi.get();     // any time after mod construction
    ServerVoiceApi server = api.server();      // logical server
    ClientVoiceApi client = api.client();      // physical client only
}

See CozyVoiceApi, ServerVoiceApi and ClientVoiceApi.

4. Listen to events

Events are normal Forge events on MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS:


@SubscribeEvent
public static void onRoute(VoiceRouteEvent e) {
    ServerPlayer sender = e.getSender();
    if (!Radio.isTransmitting(sender)) return;
    for (ServerPlayer p : sender.server.getPlayerList().getPlayers()) {
        if (p != sender && Radio.isListening(p)) {
            e.getTargets().add(new VoiceTarget(p.getUUID(), VoiceCategory.RADIO, 1f));
        }
    }
    e.setRadioEffect(true);
}

5. Mutes, groups and audio


ServerVoiceApi voice = CozyVoiceApi.get().server();
voice.mute(player.getUUID(), 300);                       // 5 minutes, fires VoiceMuteChangedEvent

VoiceGroup team = voice.createGroup("Red team", false);  // members hear each other anywhere
team.addMember(player.getUUID());

LocationalAudioChannel speaker = voice.createLocationalChannel(null, level, Vec3.atCenterOf(pos));
AudioPlayer music = voice.createAudioPlayer(speaker, nextFrameOrNull);  // 960-sample frames, null = end
music.onStopped(speaker::close);
music.start();

6. Register your addon (optional)


@CozyVoiceAddon
public final class MyVoiceAddon implements CozyVoicePlugin {
    @Override public String getId() { return "myaddon"; }

    @Override public void onRegister(CozyVoiceApi api) {
        MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS.register(MyVoiceEvents.class);
    }
}

Cozy Voice Chat finds annotated classes in Forge's scan data during common setup, creates them and calls CozyVoicePlugin.onRegister(net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.CozyVoiceApi). They are listed in the log, by /cozyvoice addons and by CozyVoiceApi.getAddons(). See CozyVoiceAddon. A complete example: CozyVoiceChat-SampleAddon.

Threads

Where each callback runs
WhatThread
VoiceConnectionEvent, VoiceRouteEvent, VoiceStateChangedEvent, VoiceRouteHookserver thread
MicrophonePacketEventnetwork thread (no world access)
ClientMicrophoneEventmicrophone thread
ClientReceiveAudioEventplayback thread
other client eventsclient thread
AudioChannel.sendPcm(short[]) / sendOpusany thread
Package
Description
net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api
Public API of Cozy Voice Chat: the entry point CozyVoiceApi, the audio categories and the routing hook.
net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.addon
Addon discovery: annotate a CozyVoicePlugin implementation with CozyVoiceAddon and Cozy Voice Chat finds, creates and registers it during common setup.
net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.audio
Audio format constants and Opus codec wrappers, so addons don't need a codec dependency of their own.
net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.client
Client-side API for the local player, from CozyVoiceApi.client().
net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.event
Server-side Forge events, posted on MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS.
net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.event.client
Client-side Forge events, posted on MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS on the physical client only.
net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.server
Server-side API, from CozyVoiceApi.server(): status queries, mutes, effects, groups and addon audio channels played through the voice relay.
